0006-use-helm-for-application-package-ma.reply: {"reasons": [{"text": "The team requires a way to define Kubernetes resources as installable packages with configuration options passed at deploy time.", "quote": "At a high level, we require a means to define an application's Kubernetes resources as an installable package, with configuration options passed in at deploy time.", "tool": null}, {"text": "The team uses Terraform for AWS infrastructure management and wants to maintain a strict separation of concerns between infrastructure and application management.", "quote": "We are currently using Terraform for AWS infrastructure management, and we should maintain a strict separation of concerns between managing cloud infrastructure and the software applications that run on top.", "tool": null}, {"text": "Helm has widespread industry adoption, a large number of existing packages, and support in the wider devops and development ecosystem.", "quote": "Helm by comparison has widespread industry adoption, a [large number of existing packages](https://artifacthub.io/packages/search), and widespread support in the wider devops and development ecosystem.", "tool": "Helm"}]}

0007-use-fluentbit-elasticsearch-and-kib.reply: {"reasons": [{"text": "The sidecar pattern does not meet the need for logging as a default service for all containers", "quote": "We must have logging as a service and enable it by default for all containers, so the sidecar pattern does not meet our needs.", "tool": null}, {"text": "The logging agent must annotate and index logs with Kubernetes cluster metadata", "quote": "To make application logs searchable and navigable, we require the logging agent to annotate and index logs with Kubernetes cluster metadata (namespace, pod name, labels, and so on).", "tool": null}, {"text": "Elasticsearch and Kibana are chosen due to their extensive support for this use case and ecosystem", "quote": "For now, the obvious choice is Elasticsearch and Kibana, due to their extensive support for this use case and in this ecosystem.", "tool": "Elasticsearch"}, {"text": "Deploying a local logging service ensures usability sooner and familiarity with Kubernetes logging details", "quote": "Doing so will ensure we have a usable logging service for our users sooner rather than later, and get familiar with the details of logging within Kubernetes ourselves.", "tool": null}]}
